question: What produces the version 1.3 movie-view transform word sampled by the coupled-fill selector, and which downstream presentation parts remain unverified?

scope.boundary: This packet identifies the current transform producer, raw-bit selector read, and downstream lazy texture-backend boundary. It does not claim runtime addresses, observed values, injected descriptors, hook placements, crashes, shader state, asset identities, or visible-result conclusions.

dependencies.use: current bounded-source, writer-selection, and descriptor-production contract
authoritative source-array cardinality and selector bounds

currentEvidence.method: current generated-code structure followed by foreground read-only Ghidra word, function, and reference queries
currentEvidence.qualification: The producer and selector use the recorded instruction-level field contract. The bounded title session observed the natural descriptor at this fill boundary, but did not establish a downstream bind.

producer.caller: 0x8222E2A0 passes movieView +0x98 in r8 to 0x82298898 at call site 0x8222E350.
producer.builder: 0x82298898 copies six consecutive single-precision values from the supplied source into context offsets +0x24 through +0x38.

field.meaning: Second element of the six-float movie-view transform copy.

producer.result: The +0x28 word is produced by an ordinary floating-point transform copy and is not an independently authored Boolean flag.

selector.behavior: The coupled-fill build loads configuration +0x28 and rotates raw bit 0x10 into a one-bit value used by the existing-format-zero branch. Format 3 is the default; format 4 additionally requires the mesh-state latch or a bounded source entry with a nonzero raw +0x0 byte.
selector.qualification: The function also tests independent eligibility bits from configuration +0x1C and +0x24. The sampled transform bit is one input to the selector, not a semantic flag or a sufficient format decision by itself.
selector.descriptorResult: The simple and complex writer outcomes remain those recorded by gfx-coupled-fill-producer; the bounded title session adds the natural source count and descriptor tuple recorded in runtimeEvidence.

textureBind.behavior: The bind path reads renderer-texture backend +0x28 and calls the ensure routine only when that field is null, then reloads the field for submission.
textureBind.qualification: The bounded title session did not observe the resolve-image, resolve-output, or texture-bind markers, so it does not establish a resolved image, bind, backend value, or visible result.

staticQuery.result: Ghidra confirms the current function starts, the sole direct call to 0x82298898 from 0x8222E350, the six-float copy words, the selector load/extract words, and the lazy backend load/call words. Generated version 1.3 bodies provide the bounded control-flow interpretation.

naturalDescriptor.result: The probe recorded the natural coupled-fill output; the probe itself performed no descriptor write or format override.

resourceCorrelation.qualification: The exact-name resource/open observations occurred in the same bounded title sessions as the natural descriptor. Dynamic descriptor, resource, image, and output pointers are not promoted as stable identities.

presentationBoundary.result: The natural path stopped being observable after descriptor/resource creation and before the first resolver or bind marker. The run then encountered repeated ObjectIcons VFS failures and exited with illegal instruction.
presentationBoundary.qualification: This identifies the first bounded observation boundary, not a causal proof that the boundary caused missing presentation.

excluded: guest-memory changes, injected mappings, forced presentation, shader state, draw results, and visible-output conclusions
a semantic interpretation of the transform word or tuple fields

gpuTextureEnumeration.method: default-off SDK texture-cache log of each distinct key committed to a load, over a bounded 25 second launch
gpuTextureEnumeration.tiledRgbaKeys: Four 64x64 content keys plus two 1280x720 endian-0 presentation surfaces.
gpuTextureEnumeration.nearestMiss: 1AEA1000:1024:256:1024:0:18:1, an untiled DXT1 key of matching geometry and unrelated format.
gpuTextureEnumeration.result: No tiled k_8_8_8_8 endian-2 key outside the 64x64 class was committed to a load. GFx images outside that class do not reach the GPU.
gpuTextureEnumeration.qualification: The enumeration is bounded to one session and records key identity only. It does not establish which guest function omits the fetch constant, nor any asset identity for a loaded key.
gpuTextureEnumeration.scopeCorrection: The shape table is bounded to the loading screen. A later 95 second interactive session counted 189440 binds at 0x82302758 with no null, unreadable, or bad-reference cases, and recorded 64x64, 16x16, 32x32, and 256x128 bound shapes. Image-sized textures therefore do bind. Do not read this table as a general claim that only 64x64 reaches the GPU.
gpuTextureEnumeration.survivingClaim: No 1024x256 tiled k_8_8_8_8 key was committed to a load, and no 1024x256 bind occurred in 189440 counted samples.

rendererBoundary.statement: The GFx core never offers the missing images to the renderer. Every renderer stage downstream of that handoff is correct.
rendererBoundary.siteRole: Textured-fill setter. Writes draw-state kind 2 and copies a nine-word fill descriptor whose word 0 is the texture.
rendererBoundary.registerRoles: Entry is 'or r11,r3,r3' then 'or r9,r4,r4'; 'lwz r7,0x0(r9)' into 'stw r7,0x21f4(r11)' makes descriptor word 0 the texture. Roles read from the instructions at the hook site.
rendererBoundary.subjectPresent: Exactly one 1024x256 upload occurred in the same session, so the absence is a measurement rather than a gap.
rendererBoundary.instrumentProof: All 81920 arguments resolved against the registry, so the site was fully understood rather than merely sampled.
rendererBoundary.stateBlocks: The renderer holds two identical state blocks at +0x21c8 and +0x223c, each carrying its texture at +0x2c. The block the dispatch reads has no field setter: its only static write to +0x2268 is a zero store, so the value arrives by bulk copy.
rendererBoundary.sizeRuleNotEstablished: An earlier session bound a 256x128 texture, so larger images can reach the renderer under some conditions. No size threshold is claimed.
rendererBoundary.staticBlocker: The GFx core producer at 0x822688C0 and the renderer vtable slots decompile only to save-register thunks or halt_baddata; undecoded VMX128 regions prevent a static read of the core side without the mutating repair chain.

openBoundary: The bounded version 1.3 runtime session identifies the natural descriptor tuple, its source-count-one fill boundary, the exact main-menu image/movie requests, type-11 cache service, and the first unobserved boundary before resolver/bind presentation. Downstream resolution, backend state, shader selection, draw completion, and the cause of missing visuals remain unverified.
guards: Do not write the transform word, force bit 0x10, or reinterpret the sampled float bits as a standalone flag.
Do not force format 4, change fill subtype, populate source selectors, or reuse an unverified validation tuple.
Do not infer a resolved image, runtime bind, backend state, shader selection, draw result, or visible outcome from the bounded pre-presentation trace.
This packet authorizes no runtime hook, launch, guest-memory write, generated-code edit, or presentation-path change.
conclusion: Version 1.3 establishes the current static architecture, and the bounded session observed the natural tuple 0,0xffffffff,0xffffffff,0xffffffff,0 at the coupled-fill source-count-one boundary. Exact GFX_MainMenu_logo.dds and GFX_MainMenu.gfx requests were served by the type-11 cache with no exact-name filesystem fallback, while no resolver, output, or texture-bind marker appeared before the run's VFS failure. The downstream presentation path and any causal explanation for missing visuals remain unproven.
